dik-dik.d: any of several small antelopes of eastern Africa of the genus Madoqua; the size of a large rabbit

dika bread.d: somewhat astringent paste prepared by grinding and heating seeds of the African wild mango; a staple food of some African peoples

dika nut.d: edible oil-rich seed of wild mango

dike.d: a barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea

dika.d: African tree with edible yellow fruit resembling mangos; valued for its oil-rich seed and hardy green wood that resists termites
